notes: The Permanent Fund Dividend: the annual cash payment to every eligible Alaska resident. Who is eligible (residency, allowable absences), the application period and the amount. The benefit most Alaskans apply for; the PFD is taxable federally (26 U.S.C. 61, general knowledge, unverified here).
